title: Graduates who are Unable to Find Jobs within Six Months of Graduation and Assessment of Job Opportunities for Them
what_it_is: Graduates who are Unable to Find Jobs within Six Months of Graduation and Assessment of Job Opportunities for Them

sections.label: IHL graduate employment rates
sections.summary: About 90% of the 2023 IHL cohort were employed within six months of graduation, comparable to pre-COVID-19 levels and the past three years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Amongst fresh IHL graduates who are looking for jobs, the employment rate has remained high and stable over the past three years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: About 90% of the 2023 cohort were employed within six months of graduation, comparable to pre-COVID-19 levels.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: Does the Ministry of Manpower have the figures for 2022 and 2021, that is, last three years?

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: They are also about 90% for the past three years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: But a good proxy is the published ratio of job vacancies to unemployed persons as a proxy for the availability of job opportunities for all workers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: This ratio has remained stable at 1.67 in June 2024 and this is an indication that our fresh graduates should still be able to find jobs.
